name: Space-Track Source
description: Parse Space-Track GP and GP-history JSON (omm-gp-json, Alpha-5 catalog numbers read) into canonical SDS OMM records and SATCAT JSON into CAT records (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON between modules). Each method takes the hostcap/http-request HttpResponse, whose BODY is the Space-Track JSON verbatim, and writes one size-prefixed record stream plus one FlowNotice report (Info: COUNT the records emitted, ITEMS the read/emitted/dropped counters and the first rejection examples as name=value). HTTP 304 gives one FlowNotice (Unchanged) on 'report' and no records; another status or a transport error is refused. No capabilities and no hostcalls: retrieval, credentials, the request rate and storage belong to the SDN host flow.

methods.displayName: Read Space-Track GP or GP history as OMM

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse from hostcap/http-request for one Space-Track gp or gp_history (omm-gp-json) request: BODY the JSON array of flat text-valued objects as the REST API serves it, bounded to 256 MiB; STATUS 200, or 304 for unchanged.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse from hostcap/http-request for one Space-Track gp or gp_history (omm-gp-json) request: BODY the JSON array of flat text-valued objects as the REST API serves it, bounded to 256 MiB; STATUS 200, or 304 for unchanged.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.

outputPorts.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method reads one complete bounded provider response in input order and writes canonical records and one report; the host parallelizes independent responses and this parser creates no threads.
